Description: ENGRAM — an AI persona framework: a cognitive-architecture companion (PYRI) plus seeded character 'engrams' with drives, memory, world models, simulations, and autonomous outreach. Ships as a web app, an Expo mobile app, a desktop (Electron) app, and an Express API server in one pnpm monorepo.
Key Commands / Notes: Refer to the monorepo as the project; each app is an artifact.

Description: pnpm workspace: artifacts/* are runnable apps (engram web, engram-mobile, api-server, mockup-sandbox); lib/* are shared packages (db, engram-core, i18n, api-spec, api-client-react, api-zod, AI integration libs); scripts/ holds operational scripts (seeding, locale generation).
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm install at the root; never use npm/yarn.

Description: pnpm v10 with workspace protocol (workspace:*) for internal deps and a catalog for some shared versions.
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm --filter @workspace/<name> run <script>

Description: Composite project references. Every new lib needs its own composite tsconfig AND an entry in the root tsconfig.json references array.
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm run typecheck:libs (tsc --build); artifacts: pnpm --filter <pkg> exec tsc --noEmit

Description: Express server exposing all REST + SSE endpoints under /api. Routes in src/routes/*, domain logic in src/lib/*, background engine in src/services/engram-engine.ts.
Key Commands / Notes: Workflow: 'artifacts/api-server: API Server'

Description: React + Vite + wouter + TanStack Query + shadcn/tailwind. Pages in src/pages/*, shared shell in src/components/layout.tsx, routes registered in src/App.tsx.
Key Commands / Notes: Workflow: 'artifacts/engram: web'

Description: Expo (SDK 54) + expo-router. Tabs in app/(tabs)/*, settings in app/server-settings.tsx, offline LLM mode under lib/offline/* using llama.rn.
Key Commands / Notes: Workflow: 'artifacts/engram-mobile: expo'

Description: Electron wrapper with embedded pglite DB seam, bundled llama.cpp offline model, auto-update via electron-builder releases.
Key Commands / Notes: See memory docs: desktop-embedded-db, bundled-offline-llm, desktop-auto-update.

Description: Pure domain logic shared by server, mobile offline mode, and desktop: prompt builders (buildSystemPrompt for PYRI, buildEngramSystemPrompt for engrams), HARD_SAFETY constraints, expression handling.
Key Commands / Notes: No DB or i18n dependency by design — callers pass data in.

Description: Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL. Schema in src/schema.ts, seed data in src/seed/engram-data.ts. Table export names sometimes differ from table names — check schema exports before importing.
Key Commands / Notes: Schema changes must be BOTH pushed and generated (dual path).

Description: Single OpenAPI source of truth. Orval generates React Query hooks (lib/api-client-react) and Zod validators (lib/api-zod).
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen after ANY spec edit.

Description: 12 languages. English namespace JSONs in src/en/ are the only authored source; src/generated/<lang>.json are machine-translated (never hand-edit). Exports resources, LANGUAGES, responseLanguageInstruction().
Key Commands / Notes: Regenerate after English copy changes: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run generate:locales [langs]

Description: All model calls go through one OpenAI-compatible client. Resolution order: LLM_BASE_URL/LLM_API_KEY/LLM_MODEL (local runtimes) else AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_* (Replit cloud).
Key Commands / Notes: Lets the same code run cloud or fully local (llama.cpp, Ollama).

Description: 1) pnpm install 2) ensure DB env vars present 3) seed reference data 4) start workflows (api-server, web, expo).
Key Commands / Notes: Seeding is manual — no auto-seed exists.

Description: Seed scripts: seed:engrams (personas from lib/db seed data), seed:expressions, seed:hub, seed:full-rezz (archival branch).
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run seed:engrams

Description: Key env: DATABASE_URL (Postgres), AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_API_KEY/_BASE_URL (cloud LLM), optional LLM_BASE_URL/LLM_API_KEY/LLM_MODEL overrides, SESSION_SECRET.
Key Commands / Notes: Never commit secrets; managed via Replit secrets.

Description: Path-based routing behind a proxy: web at /, mobile via Expo dev domain, API under /api. Frontends must use the artifact base path, never hardcoded localhost.
Key Commands / Notes: Debug with curl against $REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN.

Description: An engram = seeded persona: identity, origin, voiceProfile, drives (id/label/level), emotionalBaseline, guardrails, environment anchor. Adding one has non-obvious couplings (drive keywords enable outreach; guardrails complement HARD_SAFETY).
Key Commands / Notes: Seed appends by slug; dev DB assigns numeric ids.

Description: The system-wide companion with modes (companion/informational/alert/tutorial/analyst/silent/custom), personas, beliefs, expressions, and perceptual context.
Key Commands / Notes: Chat streams over SSE.

Description: Engram autonomy engine: ticks raise drive levels; initiation is drive-based (threshold), transmissions have cooldowns. Every autonomy guard must be DB-backed, not in-memory (restart safety).
Key Commands / Notes: Never add in-memory-only rate limits.

Description: Engram knowledge entries carry provenance (OBSERVED vs SIMULATED etc.). Simulation output is structurally quarantined and can never become OBSERVED reality. Media perception writes OBSERVED entries with hardcoded provenance and idempotent retries.
Key Commands / Notes: See simulation-quarantine and media-perception memory docs.

Description: Directed simulations step via CAS-claimed rows (never bypass the claim); engrams give in-voice exit summaries.
Key Commands / Notes: Multiple engrams per simulation is a proposed task.

Description: Two kinds: probe (pure in-character Q&A, append-only) and develop (bounded persona tuning via sanitized JSON delta). Develop deltas are clamped by sanitizeDelta and pass safety checks.
Key Commands / Notes: POST /api/engrams/:id/inquiries

Description: isArchival = read-only forever. Every engram-keyed write route needs the archival guard. Exception: probe inquiries are allowed (interactive but immutable); develop returns 403.
Key Commands / Notes: Seed atomically via seedAll.

Description: PYRI's QUERTY micro-expression vocabulary is filtered before reaching the chat prompt; intimate expression data must never reach PYRI's prompt.
Key Commands / Notes: See expression-layer-safety memory doc.

Description: HARD_SAFETY block is appended to every persona/PYRI prompt and cannot be tuned away: construct containment, no explicit content, no real-world harm or hacking instructions.
Key Commands / Notes: Guardrails/personas/develop can never override it.

Description: Edit spec -> run codegen -> generated hooks/Zod update everywhere. Avoid an operation with BOTH a path param and query params (breaks Orval here).
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen

Description: SSE streaming. Body: { content, language? }. Web/mobile use raw fetch for SSE (generated hooks don't stream).
Key Commands / Notes: language is BCP-47, allowlisted server-side.

Description: Body: { kind: probe|develop, question, language? }. Probe allowed on archival engrams; develop 403.
CRUD-ish routes for engrams, world model, transmissions, simulations, tuning. All writes must check the archival guard.
Upload -> extraction -> OBSERVED world-model entries + in-voice commentary. Processing should be treated as all-or-nothing (proposed hardening task).
i18next + react-i18next; localStorage keys engram.uiLang / engram.replyLang; document.dir flips to rtl for Arabic; one namespace per page.
Key Commands / Notes: Settings page at /settings.

Description: AsyncStorage persistence behind a single i18nReady hydration promise; resolveReplyLanguage() is async — await it at send time. Known limitation: no RTL layout on mobile (text translates, layout stays LTR).

Optional 'language' on chat + inquiry POSTs. Server maps it through responseLanguageInstruction() (allowlist) and passes the instruction into prompt builders — chat (PYRI + engram), probe, and develop all honor it.
Key Commands / Notes: Omitted/unknown code = automatic (match the user).

Description: Add to LANGUAGES (code, englishName, nativeName, rtl), create generated/<code>.json placeholder, run generate:locales <code>.
Add camelCase keys to the page's namespace JSON, use t() in the page, then regenerate locales or the other 11 languages silently fall back to English.
wouter routing in App.tsx; layout.tsx owns nav; TanStack Query + generated hooks for data; shadcn components; every interactive element keeps a data-testid.
Key Commands / Notes: Dark terminal aesthetic; mono/display font system.

Description: Streaming chat uses raw fetch + ReadableStream, NOT generated hooks.
Key Commands / Notes: See engram-chat-sse memory doc.

Description: Mobile/desktop variants sharing a Radix Dialog/Sheet must branch via a JS breakpoint hook, not CSS hidden (portals ignore CSS scoping).
Pre-existing shadcn TS errors from duplicate @types/react versions — filter these out when typechecking; they are not feature-caused.
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit | grep -v @types/react

Description: On-device llama.rn model; local handler seam mirrors server routes; safety prompts single-sourced from engram-core; mode-scoped conversation IDs; Qwen3 think-block hold-back.
Key Commands / Notes: Offline sync-back to account is a pending task.

Description: Local builds: .android-sdk, gradle in <=260s foreground windows (./gradlew :app:assembleRelease -x lint --no-daemon). llama.rn ships no .so in npm — its postinstall downloads jniLibs and pnpm blocks postinstalls: re-run install/download-native-artifacts.js after any node_modules recreation, verify with unzip -l | grep librnllama. reactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a,x86_64 only.
Key Commands / Notes: Output copied to downloads/ENGRAM-android.apk, served at /api/download/android.apk.

Description: All expo-* packages must match the installed Expo SDK (npx expo install --check). A mismatched module (e.g. expo-file-system from a newer SDK) crashes the APK at launch with NoSuchMethodError.
Key Commands / Notes: Crash-screen diagnostic: CrashActivity shows the stack trace on device.

Description: electron-builder publishes releases; updater has non-obvious constraints (draft releases, signature checks). All three installers must be present before a release goes public (proposed CI task).
Bundled llama.cpp server + model staged at build time; lifecycle managed by the app; watch workspace quota.
Cloud LLM API key is never persisted in plaintext on desktop.
Dual path: drizzle-kit push for dev AND generate for committed migrations (watch the generate out-path bug). Production schema sync is a separate step.
No auto-seed: lookup/reference data must be seeded explicitly per environment.
Vitest unit tests; route tests use a hand-rolled db/schema mock that must be kept in sync when the engine reads a new table. A shared in-memory harness is a proposed task.
Key Commands / Notes: Known pre-existing failures: 2 tests in artifact-worker.db.test.ts.

Description: Engine unit test fakes the DB; adding a table the engine reads requires extending the fake.
Playwright-based testing subagent available in the Replit workspace for UI verification.
Each artifact has a managed workflow. Restart after code/package/config changes. Artifact service config changes go through the artifact tooling, not manual .replit edits.
LLM-based, resumable per namespace (reuses translations whose key sets still match). Run per-language batches to fit command timeout windows.
Key Commands / Notes: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run generate:locales es fr

Description: Built installers/APKs are staged in downloads/ and served via /api/download/* with Range/206 support.
Production is published separately from the dev workspace; the currently published build predates recent features (Full Rezz interactivity, Sasha, i18n) until re-published.
pnpm blocks package postinstall scripts by default — native-artifact downloads (llama.rn) must be run manually after installs.
pdfkit: text placed below the bottom margin with width set appends blank pages; generate/verify PDFs without Chromium.
Prompt builders are shared by server, mobile offline, and desktop — a change affects all three; keep options optional and backward-compatible.
1) package.json with workspace name 2) composite tsconfig 3) root tsconfig references entry 4) pnpm install 5) pnpm run typecheck:libs.
